findings.evidence: Both statements mention only sets, functions and injectivity; their proofs use only `simp`, injectivity and equality rewriting, with no quadratic definitions.
findings.fix: Relocate and export these results in general set/function modules, or replace their uses with existing general API.
findings.issue: Both `apply_mem_compl_pair` and `injective_of_val_eq` (line 208) are general set/function infrastructure hidden as private, preventing reuse independently of quadratic equations.

findings.evidence: SumVars.lean:130–139 gives terminating generator reductions without annotations; Tail.lean:328,336,340 reduces tail accessors. Parallel generator lemmas and Basic.lean's constant/genus/orientability reductions already carry `@[simp]`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to these characteristic reduction lemmas.
findings.issue: `sumComplEquiv_inr_of_of_mem` and `sumComplEquiv_inr_of_of_notMem` lack `@[simp]`, so generator images do not simplify automatically even with membership known. The same omission affects `constant_tail`, `genus_tail`, and `isOrientable_tail_iff` in Tail.lean.

summary: Two general infrastructure lemmas are hidden in the quadratic module, and characteristic reduction lemmas lack automation annotations.
